build_split.vps_side_goal: finish contracts, CaptureOwner/Broker semantics, deterministic control, scheduling, world-model fusion, bridge semantics, fixtures, CI and release wiring so local Claude Code/Opus integration is primarily real hardware/OS binding plus acceptance
build_split.local_final_goal: bind actual sensors/device adapters/permissions/dashboard and execute hardware acceptance without inventing new architecture

workpackages.title: PerceptionSource + PerceptionCapability + immutable permission snapshot
acceptance: source registry supports 0..N configured sources and never assumes four sources
per-source SEE/ANALYZE/MEMORY/RAW_RETENTION/REMOTE_FRAME/EXTERNAL_VLM represented
snapshot has exact digest/generation/provenance
revoked or stale snapshot cannot authorize new work
queued observation work revalidates current owner policy before execution
source add/remove/rebind does not silently preserve obsolete capability authority

workpackages.title: ObserveIntent and VisualNeed binding
acceptance: VisualNeed can compile to bounded ObserveIntent without performing capture
intent binds source, ROI, heads, freshness, deadline, priority, compute ceiling and permission digest
intent has no truth/effect/completion authority
permission revocation after intent creation causes fail-closed execution
REMOTE_FRAME and EXTERNAL_VLM are rechecked at actual transfer/dispatch time
expired intent cannot be replayed after bridge delay/reconnect

workpackages.title: RetinaCaptureBroker single-owner/multiple-reader contract
acceptance: CaptureOwner/Broker state machine and bounded fan-out are implemented before local handoff
one capture owner per source
bounded in-memory references/ring
no unbounded queue growth
consumer fan-out cannot reopen/contend for underlying source
historical duplicate-device-open / Device-busy class has explicit regression falsifier
real local OS/device adapter can plug into the prebuilt CaptureOwner interface without redesigning ownership semantics

workpackages.title: Dynamic Retina/Cortex worker scheduler 0..4
acceptance: 0..4 active analysis slots selected under explicit compute policy
source count independent of worker count
N sources greater than active worker count are handled by bounded scheduling/backpressure
zero-worker state is valid while admitted cheap Retina capture/change monitoring can continue
stale low-value work coalesced/dropped under backpressure
perception cannot exceed cognitive envelope ceilings or starve state/control latency

workpackages.title: Temporal ObservationWindow and cross-source fusion
acceptance: source-local monotonic ordering preserved
source time, capture monotonic time, freshness and clock-domain/skew metadata explicit
cross-clock claims carry bounded clock uncertainty or explicit UNKNOWN/UNALIGNED state
fusion uses an explicit admissible temporal window/skew policy
arrival order is never silently treated as event-time order
same GRID cycle is never silently treated as same real-world time
stale or temporally unaligned observations cannot silently become current world state
multi-view disagreement preserved

workpackages.title: PerceptionWorldBridge typed events / ObserveIntent return path
acceptance: typed percept events are default bridge payload
raw/ROI bridge requires REMOTE_FRAME capability at actual transfer time
VLM path additionally requires EXTERNAL_VLM capability at actual dispatch time
bridge loss degrades without corrupting local identity or fabricating observations
bridge reconnect cannot replay expired ObserveIntent or stale permission authority
stale remote events cannot be promoted to current world truth merely by late arrival

workpackages.title: Dashboard capability plane and PerceptionAuditReceipt contract
acceptance: dashboard can pause all Retina and revoke each capability per source
live worker/source/reason visibility
auditable permission snapshot and observation execution receipts
dashboard binds to the same capability authority used by CaptureOwner/ObserveIntent rather than a UI-only preference copy
raw keylogging/clipboard/password capture excluded from baseline
permission withdrawal behavior is testable and visible

workpackages.title: Perception Fabric sustained multi-source acceptance
acceptance: 0-source case keeps cognition healthy and fabricates no observations
1-source basic capture/event/re-look path passes
N-sources-greater-than-workers scheduling path passes
four permissioned sources can be represented concurrently when four real or synthetic sources are available
0..4 workers adapt dynamically
zero generic VLM calls in normal baseline soak
zero raw-frame persistence under default policy
bounded RAM/queues
world model receives typed epistemic/time/source provenance
GRID10-triggered re-look works
source add/remove/rebind churn is tolerated without state/authority corruption
permission revocation during queued ObserveIntent invalidates outstanding work
clock-skew/uncertainty falsifier prevents false contemporaneous fusion
MEMORY_OFF evidence is not later resurrected from durable memory
bridge disconnect/reconnect does not replay stale visual authority
resource-pressure test drops/degrades perception work before cognition/control starvation
final local Claude Code/Opus run repeats enabled real-device/OS-permission acceptance before product completion

completion_law: Frankenstein 2.0 perception integration is incomplete if final local Claude Code/Opus work must invent permission, CaptureOwner/Broker ownership, scheduling, epistemic, temporal-fusion, world-model or bridge semantics rather than only bind host-specific sensors/device adapters/permissions and verify them. The hardening contract is part of these acceptance semantics.
